item.title: Spanish high-speed train collision results in 31 deaths
item.description: An accident involving two high-speed trains in Spain's Toledo province caused at least 31 deaths and 80 injuries on Wednesday. The leader of the Castilla-La Mancha area stated that casualties are expected to increase as rescue efforts continue.

item.title: Former Minister Urges Dialogue Following Attack Amid Dam Opposition
item.description: A former minister condemned the destruction of property during demonstrations opposing a dam project in Arunachal Pradesh. While supporting peaceful assembly, he warned participants to avoid destructive behavior and pursue negotiations.

item.title: AAP Threatens Protests Over Delhi Alcohol App While Agency Defends It
item.description: An AAP politician warned of large-scale demonstrations against the BJP administration regarding a digital platform that lets buyers purchase alcohol online for pickup. Meanwhile, officials stated the platform received official clearance in 2024.

item.title: Spanish Train Collision Prompts Indian Embassy Helpline Release
item.description: Following a train collision, the Indian embassy in Madrid shared emergency contact details and helpline numbers for citizens affected by the incident to seek assistance.

item.title: Putin Praises Musk as Russia Develops Satellite Network
item.description: The Russian leader commended the entrepreneur's intellect and confirmed communication with the satellite network's owner as Moscow works on establishing its own space-based communication system.

item.title: Cyclone Arnab Makes Landfall in Andhra Pradesh and Weakens
item.description: The India Meteorological Department reports that severe cyclone Arnab has moved completely onshore after crossing the Andhra coastline. Chief Minister Naidu confirmed that officials have logged no fatalities so far.

item.title: শাহজালালে ২৪ কোটি টাকার সোনা উদ্ধার
item.description: ঢাকার হজরত শাহজালাল আন্তর্জাতিক বিমানবন্দরে দুই যাত্রীর কাছ থেকে ১২ কেজি ৬০ গ্রাম সোনা জব্দ করেছে কাস্টমস কর্তৃপক্ষ। জিনস প্যান্ট ও অন্তর্বাসে সেলাই করে লুকিয়ে রাখা এসব সোনার আনুমানিক বাজারমূল্য ২৪ কোটি টাকা।

item.title: Tihar Jail Inmates Observe Karva Chauth Festival
item.description: Roughly 250 to 300 female detainees at Tihar's Jail No. 6 fasted for Karva Chauth. Additionally, families scheduled 1,200 visiting appointments across the prison facility for Thursday.

item.title: Jolie-Backed NGO Secures Legal Aid for Thousands of Youths
item.description: Established in 2008 by Angelina Jolie, Kids in Need of Defense has provided legal counsel and mental health support to over 17,000 unaccompanied minors throughout Mexico and the US.

item.title: Burnley Names Fabio Celestini New Head Coach
item.description: Fabio Celestini has taken over as the head coach of Burnley, following the exit of Nicky Hayen four days prior.

item.title: US Federal Reserve maintains interest rates amid high inflation
item.description: By a 10-2 margin, the FOMC kept rates at 3.75 to 4.00 percent. The panel stated additional data is required before adjusting monetary policy to combat rising prices.

item.title: Sony launches transparent PS5 controllers alongside matching covers
item.description: The manufacturer has introduced translucent DualSense gamepads. Corresponding faceplates for the PlayStation 5 console are launching as well.

item.title: Babydoll vocalist reflects on life post-UK chart success
item.description: Following a challenging phase that caused him to abandon his music career, the performer achieved a UK number one and is experiencing happiness once more.

item.title: Google and Xreal release lightweight augmented reality glasses for $1,099
item.description: Weighing 95 grams, the new Aura eyewear features a connected Android XR processing unit and several virtual displays. The device officially went on sale today.

item.title: Arab factions perform strongly in Israeli elections, threatening Netanyahu
item.description: During Tuesday's vote, supporters of two major Arab parties cast record ballots to oppose Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, potentially paving the way for his exit.

item.title: Airlines set to relocate some Mumbai flights to Navi Mumbai
item.description: During a Wednesday gathering with airline representatives, airport officials announced that IndiGo, Air India, and Akasa Air will transfer international flights serving three million yearly travelers to Navi Mumbai.

item.title: Thakurgaon-1 by-election rivals exchange accusations on eve of vote
item.description: On Wednesday, candidates from the BNP and Jamaat held press briefings to level mutual complaints ahead of the Thakurgaon-1 parliamentary by-election scheduled for the following day.

item.title: Balad chief condemns exclusion of Arab factions in Israel
item.description: Following an inconclusive election, the opposition coalition has declined to partner with Arab political factions, prompting sharp criticism from a Balad leader over what he termed racist exclusion.

item.title: UK tax bands frozen for another three years
item.description: The income levels at which individuals begin paying income tax and higher tax rates will stay the same for an additional three years, impacting take-home pay.

item.title: Survivors recall fatal Spanish train derailment
item.description: Passengers aboard the Madrid-to-Seville service recounted sudden trauma following a derailment that resulted in at least 68 fatalities and left numerous carriages filled with severely injured travelers.

item.title: Smith anticipates recovery for New Zealand series after joint scan
item.description: Medical imaging revealed a joint problem for Smith, who withdrew from the Newlands match due to persistent discomfort, though he is anticipated to recover in time to play New Zealand.

item.title: New newsletter examines questionable health and tech products
item.description: Victoria Song's weekly newsletter analyzes newly released gadgets and wellness items making dubious claims, drawing parallels to past controversies.

item.title: Congress aims for one million attendees at upcoming Ramlila rally
item.description: Congress MP Nasir Hussain stated that the party is aiming to mobilize one million participants for the November 1 Ramlila rally, with all INDIA alliance members sharing responsibility for the event's success.

item.title: Texas Boy Raises $20,000 for Heart Research
item.description: Eleven-year-old Texas student Ryan Ragsdale collected more than $20,000 for charity by parting with his personal belongings, including Pokémon cards. He has been running similar fundraising efforts with the American Heart Association since he was five.

item.title: Myanmar's UN Envoy Makes Emotional Plea
item.description: Kyaw Moe Tun, Myanmar's ambassador to the United Nations, broke down in tears while asking the global community to stop the suffering in his homeland. He criticized international actors for letting down the nation's citizens.

item.title: Ticket Pre-sale Altered After Bot Interference
item.description: Musician Sam Fender announced that an advanced bot attack disrupted the online ticketing platform for his upcoming concerts in Newcastle. Consequently, the ticket pre-sale schedule had to be adjusted.

item.title: Maharashtra MLC Elections Update
item.description: The governing Mahayuti alliance secured two victories in the Maharashtra legislative council elections while vote tabulation proceeded for remaining positions. Meanwhile, the opposition NCP SP took the lead in two districts, prompting the ruling party to seek self-evaluation.

item.title: South Africa Deals With Player Fitness Issues
item.description: Proteas fast bowler Kagiso Rabada experienced stomach cramps while teammate Marco Jansen dealt with back stiffness during the match. Jansen briefly left the field after tea, and Rabada is anticipated to return for the third day of play.

item.title: Amazon Updates Smart Speaker With Camera
item.description: Amazon has upgraded its advanced Echo Studio device by integrating home camera capabilities. This update allows the smart speaker to visually perceive and comprehend objects positioned directly in front of its lens.

item.title: Apple Prepares macOS for Touchscreen Laptops
item.description: Apple has revealed its inaugural MacBook featuring a touchscreen interface, entering a market long dominated by Windows. The company is maintaining the core macOS design rather than making sweeping modifications for touch navigation.

item.title: Jamia University Extends Virtual Classes
item.description: Jamia has prolonged its online instruction period through November 24 and announced that examinations will be conducted remotely. Winter break is scheduled from late December to early January 2027, with the subsequent semester starting on January 13.

item.title: Healey asks ministries for 1 percent budget trim for military
item.description: Government agencies must reduce their budgets by one percent to finance the Defense Investment Plan. Defense Secretary Healey announced the spending adjustment measures.

item.title: সরকার যুক্তরাষ্ট্র থেকে গম আনতে দুটি মার্কিন প্রতিষ্ঠানের দর খতিয়ে দেখবে
item.description: জিটুজি পদ্ধতিতে যুক্তরাষ্ট্র থেকে গম আমদানির প্রস্তাব দিয়েছে দুটি মার্কিন প্রতিষ্ঠান। অর্থনৈতিক বিষয়–সংক্রান্ত মন্ত্রিসভা কমিটি সর্বনিম্ন দরদাতার সঙ্গে দর–কষাকষির নীতিগত অনুমোদন দিয়েছে।

item.title: Yamuna river cruise service to start ahead of Chhath festival
item.description: Authorities plan to launch a cruise on the Yamuna river prior to the Chhath celebrations. Water quality metrics indicate the river remains contaminated with high organic waste levels.

item.title: Review of the Cadillac Escalade IQ electric SUV
item.description: The luxury three-row electric vehicle features a battery exceeding 200 kWh. It delivers an operational range of 460 miles on a single charge.

item.title: Majithia challenges AAP to substantiate narcotics allegations
item.description: Akali politician Bikram Singh Majithia demanded the AAP administration substantiate or retract drug trade accusations. He claimed leaders are repeating old claims for political advantage.

item.title: Details on upcoming January energy support payments of 100 pounds
item.description: Millions of people are set to receive a 100-pound energy disbursement beginning in January. This overview outlines eligibility requirements and the expected distribution timeline.

item.title: India wins historic silver medals at World Wrestling Championships
item.description: Kajal Dhochak and Neelam Sirohi secured silver medals in Astana, marking the first time Indian women reached the finals at the tournament. Kajal was defeated 6-8 by Ukraine's Anastasiya Alpyeyeva.

item.title: বেসরকারি অ্যাম্বুলেন্সের ধর্মঘটে রোগীদের চরম দুর্ভোগ
item.description: স্থায়ী পার্কিংয়ের দাবির আন্দোলনে বেসরকারি অ্যাম্বুলেন্স চলাচল বন্ধ রাখেন মালিক ও চালকেরা। এতে জরুরি রোগী এবং মরদেহ পরিবহনে বিকল্প ব্যবস্থা খুঁজতে গিয়ে মারাত্মক কষ্ট পোহান সাধারণ মানুষ।

item.title: Filmmaker Peter Medak Dies at 88 in Los Angeles
item.description: The Hungarian-born actor and filmmaker, known for helming movies like The Changeling and The Krays, has passed away at age 88 in Los Angeles. Over a six-decade career, he directed 27 feature films.

item.title: Australia Strengthens Position in Test Despite Labuschagne Struggles
item.description: Marnus Labuschagne experienced a new career low in performance, yet emerging Australian players stepped up to secure a solid standing for the team in the final Test against South Africa.

item.title: Apple Introduces Touchscreen MacBook Pro Lineup
item.description: The technology company has released a brand-new MacBook Pro featuring a touchscreen interface, with pricing beginning at $2,899.

item.title: US Military Prepares Potential Expanded Iran Strikes Awaiting Trump
item.description: American armed forces are getting ready for potential military operations against Iran that may extend past restricted targets like radar and missile sites, pending presidential approval.

item.title: Mumbai Airport Outlines Terminal 1 Modernization Plans
item.description: The airport authority has revealed a blueprint for Terminal 1's overhaul, aimed at boosting passenger capacity and upgrading the overall travel environment alongside visual changes.

item.title: Google AI Avoids 2020 US Election Queries Domestically
item.description: Google's artificial intelligence system becomes evasive when questioned about the outcome of the 2020 US presidential vote, though it answers more directly outside the United States.

item.title: India September Domestic Air Travel Dips While IndiGo Leads
item.description: Domestic passenger volume dropped in September while IndiGo maintained its top market position. Meanwhile, the Air India Group transported 3.165 million travelers, capturing a combined 26.8 percent market share.

item.title: Israel Sees Highest Voter Turnout Since 1999 Driven by Key Issues
item.description: Voter participation for the 26th Knesset hit 77.7 percent by late evening, marking the highest level since 1999 and exceeding the 2022 figure of 70.6 percent amid concerns over security, inflation, and casualties.

item.title: Nanjangud Launches Comprehensive Village Development Initiative
item.description: A new integrated development initiative for rural areas has been officially launched in Nanjangud. The program aims to boost local infrastructure and community welfare.

item.title: Moscow Hosts Summit to Strengthen Russia-Africa Ties
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin welcomed African officials to Moscow on Wednesday for the third Russia-Africa Summit. The delegations met to discuss bilateral cooperation in trade, security, and agriculture.
